businessName.title: Business Name
businessName.description: The name of the professional or business as listed on Expertise.com.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Direct link to this professional's card on the Expertise.com listing page.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: Position in the Expertise.com ranked list for this category and city. 1 = top pick. Featured listings appear first (positions 1–3).

isFeatured.title: Featured
isFeatured.description: Whether this is a featured (boosted) listing. Featured listings appear at the top of the ranked list.

category.title: Category
category.description: Service category slug from Expertise.com (e.g. personal-injury-lawyers, roofing, accountant-cpa).

address.title: Address
address.description: Full business address including street, city, state, and zip code.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Business phone number in US format (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

website.title: Website
website.description: Business website URL. Null if the business has opted out of displaying their website.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Average review rating aggregated across Google, Yelp, Facebook, and other platforms (0–5 scale).

reviewCount.title: Review Count
reviewCount.description: Total number of reviews aggregated across all review platforms.

expertiseScore.title: Expertise Score
expertiseScore.description: Expertise.com's internal quality score based on professionalism, friendliness, helpfulness, knowledge, and responsiveness.

description.title: Description
description.description: Editorial description of the professional or business written by Expertise.com.
description.example: Smith & Associates specializes in personal injury cases with over 15 years of experience...

services.title: Services
services.description: List of service specialties or practice areas for this professional.

licenseNumber.title: License Number
licenseNumber.description: Professional license number if available (common for home services contractors).

licenseStatus.title: License Status
licenseStatus.description: Current status of the professional license (e.g. Active, Expired).

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: Whether this listing is a boosted/verified partner on Expertise.com.

primaryContact.title: Primary Contact
primaryContact.description: Name of the primary contact or principal at the business, if listed.

providerId.title: Provider ID
providerId.description: Expertise.com's internal unique identifier for this professional.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped At
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was scraped.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key fields for lead generation: name, ranking, contact info, rating, and profile link.

details.title: Full Details
details.description: All fields including address, services, license info, and description.
